title: ajania parviflora
intro: Ajania parviflora, commonly known as Chinese Chrysanthemum or Small-Flowered Chrysanthemum, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). The health benefits of Ajania parviflora include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic agent, which may help in managing conditions such as arthritis and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Ajania parviflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
